# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)
The adapter targets NextItNet: item embeddings feed causal dilated convolutions, residual blocks and positionwise normalization. Structure inspection also recognizes a cumulative-prefix/depth gate that can extend endpoint reach across the retained history. Model forward code is not supplied, so structural conclusions remain conditional.

`log2feats(sequence)` supplies B × L × D features. Final user representations use the **largest nonpadding index**, correctly handling left padding.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks
`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses the trained network through `view.model`, embeddings through `view.item_emb`, mapped histories through `view.user_train`, and scores through `view.predict_score(features, items)`.

`run_full_diagnosis(train_loader)` consumes up to ten `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` batches and separately samples identified training users. Probes run without gradients in evaluation mode; module modes and global random states are restored afterward.

# Probes & Metrics
- **Training separation:** positive-minus-negative margin summaries, negative-win rate, margin-below-0.5 rate and tie-adjusted pairwise accuracy. Better separation suggests stronger sampled training discrimination; margins depend on score scale.
- **Representation geometry:** item and endpoint norms, centered covariance eigenvalues, leading variance share, entropy effective rank and average angular alignment. Concentration can reveal restricted representations, but broader geometry does not establish ranking quality.
- **Candidate-depth audit:** training-prefix targets face nested sets of 99/499/999 negatives over ten repetitions. Reports rank, hit@10, tenth-negative margin, eligibility and strata. Up to 50 users receive exact eligible-pool ranks and hypergeometric sampling expectations; coverage and recommendation frequency are descriptive.

# Perturbation & Tests
Identity, batch reordering, future-token changes, reachable-offset checks and removable-padding tests examine determinism, causality and padding behavior.

Old/recent deletions measure endpoint training-margin changes. Identified-user probes additionally apply random/interior deletion, zero replacement, frequency-matched replacement and repeated shuffling at 25%/50% strengths. Fixed candidate scores measure sensitivity, with paired user bootstrap intervals and common-eligibility comparisons. Sensitivity alone does not imply relevance or improvement.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations
The result contains `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, including structure, checks, representations, training separation, interventions, sensitivity, candidate-depth audits, missingness and elapsed time. `diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` requests JSON interpretation with status, findings, implications and evidence.

Held-out validation interventions and four-category macro results are unavailable here. Metadata categories and simulator traits are unobserved. Training-prefix targets may have been optimized during fitting; bootstrap intervals exclude training-seed and adaptive-search uncertainty. No auxiliary predictor is fitted.
